title: ICAI ने जारी किया 77वां वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन और लेखा (2025-26)
content:
# ICAI ने जारी किया 77वां वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन और लेखा (2025-26)

Ek important update hai! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne financial year 2025-26 ke liye apna 77th Annual Report and Accounts publish kar diya hai.

Yeh report members aur stakeholders ko Institute ki activities, financial performance, governance initiatives, aur key developments ki comprehensive overview provide karta hai.

Kuch key details:

*   **Financial Year Covered:** The report covers the financial year ended on March 31, 2026.
*   **Publication Date:** The announcement regarding the report's publication was issued by ICAI on August 6, 2026.
*   **Statutory Compliance:** This publication is in compliance with the statutory requirements prescribed under Section 18 (5B) of the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949.
*   **Gazette Publication:** The report was published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part III, Section 4, dated July 31, 2026.
*   **Hard Copy Request:** Members interested in a physical copy can send their request with membership number and postal address to the Joint Secretary, Council Affairs, ICAI Bhawan, New Delhi.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.icai.org/post/77th-annual-report-and-accounts-of-the-institute-for-the-year-2025-26-06-08-2026)

*Published on: 8 August 2026*
